}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:41.600
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:42.480
    | text      = So obviously there was some big news in the world of right wing media and propaganda this week.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:47.600
    | text      = As the head of Turning Point USA, Charlie Kirk, was shot and killed at an event he was holding
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:52.399
    | text      = on the campus of Utah Valley University on Wednesday.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:56.399
    | text      = An incident like this can be really difficult to address.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:59.120
    | text      = And this case in particular is even more messy than some other kind of similar events that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:04.480
    | text      = have happened in the past.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:06.240
    | text      = As soon as news broke of the shooting, tons of politicians from both parties came out
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:10.079
    | text      = with statements denouncing political violence and offering condolences.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:14.000
    | text      = Simultaneously, lots of people with large social media accounts released some pretty
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:18.000
    | text      = inflammatory responses, with many people mocking Charlie Kirk and others saying that a shooting
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:22.959
    | text      = was pretext for literal war against the left.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:26.319
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:27.300
    | text      = In the broken media space that we all currently live in, all of this messaging blends together
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:32.740
    | text      = and everything becomes a confusing stew of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:35.860
    | text      = In most online spaces, anonymous shitposters have as much or more reach than PhD holding
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.899
    | text      = journalists.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:41.620
    | text      = So who can keep track of who's saying what?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:43.779
    | text      = It's all just being bombarded at you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:46.580
    | text      = Personally, I think everyone who listens to this show knows exactly what I would say about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:50.019
    | text      = Charlie Kirk as a media figure the day before he was shot, and his getting shot doesn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:53.940
    | text      = change anything about how I feel about the toxic bullshit he disseminated.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:57.539
    | text      = However, as much as I may have hated everything he stands for, I wouldn't have wished death
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.659
    | text      = upon him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:03.779
    | text      = At the same time, now that it has happened, I'm not particularly interested in caring
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:08.659
    | text      = that much about it or scolding anyone for responding however they feel they need to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.940
    | text      = respond.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:15.139
    | text      = As of the point of we're recording this episode, we don't know who did the shooting or why,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:19.779
    | text      = so deconstructing what led us to this point is a little premature.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:23.539
    | text      = And I think that we can deal with more of that as we learn more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.659
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:27.460
    | text      = To be totally clear though, I do think that delighting in someone else's death, even someone
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:32.259
    | text      = who sucks, is not good for you as a person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:35.059
    | text      = And I think people would be wise to avoid doing too much of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:38.419
    | text      = Beyond that, I don't want to get into a thing where I'm saying that people should take
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:41.539
    | text      = the high road, and I also don't want to engage in people wallowing in mocking death.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:46.419
    | text      = Both of these responses feel hollow to me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:49.059
    | text      = People naturally have made a lot of assumptions about who could be behind the shooting, and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:52.899
    | text      = it seems like folks in the right wing media have decided that it must be a left wing person,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:57.539
    | text      = possibly Antifa.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:58.820
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:59.460
    | text      = It's possible that the shooter will end up being someone with left-leaning politics,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:03.460
    | text      = but it's also just as likely that someone from the far right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:07.299
    | text      = As much as someone like me may have not liked Kirk, the people who were further to the right
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.779
    | text      = hated him even more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:13.539
    | text      = Nick Fuentes and the Groypers infiltrated Kirk's organization, and they've tried to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.100
    | text      = unseen him for years, largely because he's not anti-Semitic enough for their tastes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:22.899
    | text      = That particular branch of the right wing really hates Kirk, and the idea that someone with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:26.980
    | text      = those beliefs would kill him, that's not impossible.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:30.259
    | text      = On top of that, Kirk has been a huge media figure that's gone against other ends of the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:34.259
    | text      = far right in recent months, notably being one of the big influencers who said that he
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:38.500
    | text      = was going to trust his friends in the Trump administration when they told everyone to
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:42.179
    | text      = move on from the Epstein stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:44.419
    | text      = He also wasn't opposed to Trump attacking Iran, and has been a solid supporter of Israel
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:48.740
    | text      = throughout the genocide in Gaza, which naturally has made him an enemy of people on the left
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:53.139
    | text      = and right who oppose that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:55.220
    | text      = Ultimately, I can't answer the question of who did it or why they did it, so I don't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:59.299
    | text      = want to take a ton of time speculating about that here on the show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:03.379
    | text      = I heard about the shooting pretty soon after it happened, and I saw on Twitter that there
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:07.139
    | text      = was a video that was taken from a pretty far away vantage point.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:11.539
    | text      = I watched it, and it looked like Kirk might have just been hit, and it looked like it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:14.980
    | text      = might have been survivable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:16.820
    | text      = Then, before I knew it, there was another video from much closer, and I really wish
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:20.500
    | text      = I hadn't seen it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:21.779
    | text      = The first thing I thought when I saw the closer video was that dude is gone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:25.059
    | text      = It was a horrible thing to see, and just, bleh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:28.820
    | text      = I think that seeing death and killing in particular causes a certain amount of emotional
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:33.220
    | text      = trauma to a viewer, and it really struck me how huge of a psychologically resonant event
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:38.659
    | text      = this has to have been.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:40.580
    | text      = I may think Kirk sucks, but he had a ton of fans and people who look up to him within
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:44.899
    | text      = Turning Point, and they were seeing that person that they admired die in front of a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:49.059
    | text      = crowd.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.100
    | text      = Sure, maybe they shouldn't have looked up to him, maybe that was dumb of them, or they
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:54.500
    | text      = chose a bad person to admire, but they did, and the sight of him being killed has to have
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:59.779
    | text      = hurt so many people in a way that's going to be really hard to process and predict what
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:05.139
    | text      = the outcome of that's going to be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.980
    | text      = I feel for those people, and the people who didn't like him who may have also accidentally
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:11.700
    | text      = watched something they really shouldn't have on Twitter, and are feeling something about
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:16.820
    | text      = it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.860
    | text      = When I say something like that, I can imagine some people saying, getting the impression
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:23.220
    | text      = that all this death and horrible sights, they should be censored from social media, like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:27.940
    | text      = that's my perspective.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:29.700
    | text      = And that my position would mean banning documenting atrocities that are carried out in Gaza or
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:34.179
    | text      = in other parts of the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:35.860
    | text      = But I want to make a distinction clear.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:37.860
    | text      = When people see documentation of human rights violations and war crimes somewhere like Gaza,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:42.179
    | text      = they're going to have a certain amount of emotional trauma that comes from that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.779
    | text      = However, in that case, they can take that trauma and make it something productive.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:50.100
    | text      = They can find like-minded people, and through community with these people, it's possible
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:54.500
    | text      = to funnel those feelings of trauma into advocacy and action that's meant to stop these atrocities,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:59.059
    | text      = and ideally limit them in the future.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:01.620
    | text      = That isn't possible with videos like the one of Kirk being shot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:04.899
    | text      = The trauma that this type of video inflicts on you can't be redirected towards something
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:09.539
    | text      = good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:10.340
    | text      = There isn't a real advocacy that can be fueled by the awareness that this trauma brings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:14.659
    | text      = It leads just to pain, and then that pain can be misdirected pretty easily against whoever
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:22.100
    | text      = someone wants to target.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:23.220
    | text      = For sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:24.100
    | text      = To sum this up, I hope everyone's taken care of themselves.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:26.980
    | text      = It's not normal for public figures to be shot at events, and for graphic videos of them
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:31.299
    | text      = dying to be distributed around the world immediately.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:33.860
    | text      = So if that feels weird and fucked up to you, that's okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:37.620
    | text      = It is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:38.019
    | text      = That's a very normal response.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:39.779
    | text      = How it works.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:41.059
    | text      = I wrestled with whether or not we should do an episode about this today, because there's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:44.340
    | text      = just so little information available, but we can still cover Alex's response to this
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:49.700
    | text      = breaking news without knowing a bunch of the underlying details of what happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:54.740
    | text      = We can still view his behavior as it is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:58.580
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:59.539
    | text      = And know that he doesn't really know anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:02.820
    | text      = Yeah, and we can be aware that he doesn't care, while we do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:09.379
    | text      = So Alex's show begins like any other day on Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:12.820
    | text      = There was news about Russian aggression, this time flying drones over Poland.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:17.220
    | text      = So Alex is calling that a false flag where Putin's a victim.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:19.940
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:20.580
    | text      = Russia claims that these drones are attacking Ukraine and didn't violate Poland's airspace.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:24.580
    | text      = Well, Poland has said that they documented 19 incursions into their airspace, and that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:29.379
    | text      = it simply defies imagination, it could be accidental.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:32.259
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:32.980
    | text      = It seems like a lot of experts believe there wasn't any intent on Russia's part to attack
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:37.379
    | text      = Poland, but there was a desire to test boundaries.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:39.860
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:40.659
    | text      = This kind of thing doesn't mean the end of the world is upon us, but it's a bad sign.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:44.500
    | text      = Anyway, it's an issue involving Russia, so Alex believes Putin's the good guy in the
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:48.100
    | text      = whole situation, which is, that's not a surprise.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:51.059
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:51.460
    | text      = It's not really all that interesting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:53.059
    | text      = I like the idea of thinking you're the good guy who's like, hey, here's how you know
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:57.779
    | text      = I'm the good guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:58.740
    | text      = I'm sending in a bunch of stuff to test your defenses when you're not paying attention.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:02.820
    | text      = You know, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:03.299
    | text      = Like the good guy does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:04.419
    | text      = See if you'll get your NATO buddies involved.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:06.340
    | text      = Here's what I'm going to do.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:07.220
    | text      = I'm going to annoy you until I test whether or not you're going to start some shit, and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:12.179
    | text      = then maybe I'll take your stuff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:13.700
    | text      = Like the good guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:15.460
    | text      = It's really what a hero does.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:17.700
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:18.740
    | text      = So about halfway through the show, Alex leaves.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:22.740
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:23.220
    | text      = And he just-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:23.860
    | text      = Oh, what a day for him to leave halfway through the show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:26.820
    | text      = I bet he's going to come back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:28.179
    | text      = Dan, I bet he's going to come back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:30.340
    | text      = Maybe not.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:58.179
    | text      = Stay with us, Paul Revers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:00.419
    | text      = Today's the best day of my life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:02.340
    | text      = God, I know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:03.139
    | text      = I'm going to get my dad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:04.500
    | text      = I can't tell you exactly- I can tell you exactly how it feels to be having such a great day
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:09.700
    | text      = that suddenly turns horrible immediately.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:12.980
    | text      = Just a semi-truck comes out of nowhere, two bones here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:16.419
    | text      = There we go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:17.139
    | text      = Okay, here we are.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:18.500
    | text      = So Alex leaves to- well, he actually doesn't end up leaving for a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:22.740
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:23.460
    | text      = He intends to leave.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:24.980
    | text      = Harrison Smith takes over the show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:27.700
    | text      = And as he's trying to minimize this news about Russia sending drones-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:32.740
    | text      = No big deal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:33.379
    | text      = Yeah, they're kind of like dumb drones.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:35.299
    | text      = Eh, what about the lazy drones?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:37.379
    | text      = Yeah, Harrison gets the news.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:39.460
    | text      = Uh oh.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:40.820
    | text      = But what they are is very cheap sort of distraction drones.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:44.019
    | text      = It's a cheap long-range drone which Ukraine intelligence says is made of materials like
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:47.620
    | text      = plywood and foam and assembled at Russia's vast Yelabuga facility.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:52.980
    | text      = Yelabuga?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:53.379
    | text      = It can be used as a decoy, drawing the attention of air defenses away from much pricier Shahed
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:57.860
    | text      = drones, which often carry powerful warheads.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:00.580
    | text      = However, analysts say that since its introduction, other versions of the Gerbera with light warheads
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:05.140
    | text      = or reconnaissance equipment have emerged.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:06.900
    | text      = So for the most part, these are just sort of huge model airplanes, like balsa wood airplanes
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:14.099
    | text      = that they send out in a first wave or send out along with the actual armed, expensive,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:19.059
    | text      = fancy attack drones as a way to, you know, confuse air defenses because they can shoot
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:24.980
    | text      = these sort of useless drones out of the sky and it doesn't cost them anything and it allows
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:29.059
    | text      = the, you know, actual payloads to be delivered.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:32.579
    | text      = Poland has asked NATO to invoke Article 4.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:35.140
    | text      = Officially at this point, Warsaw wants consultations with block members after an alleged violation
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:39.460
    | text      = of its airspace by drones it identified as Russian.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:44.420
    | text      = Whoa, what?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:45.220
    | text      = Charlie Kirk just got shot?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:48.019
    | text      = Fuck.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:49.059
    | text      = Sorry, the crew just came in my ear and said that Charlie Kirk just got shot on video?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:54.900
    | text      = So there's a, there's a, naturally a disbelief of like, what, what do you, what do you say?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:00.019
    | text      = I'm in the middle of talking about these drones.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:02.579
    | text      = What a day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:03.380
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:03.700
    | text      = He had no idea this is, you know, much like on January 6th, except on January 6th, he
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:09.460
    | text      = probably kind of had an idea.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:10.339
    | text      = Well, slightly different.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:11.700
    | text      = Slightly different circumstances.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:12.980
    | text      = Harrison is once again thrust into the position of being on air during something huge.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:21.619
    | text      = Poor guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:22.500
    | text      = I bet when he was a baby, like he was briefly, uh, like carried on screen as the twin towers
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | timestamp = 00:18:29.940
    | text      = fell.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:30.500
    | text      = Like he's just always there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:31.859
    | text      = He's somehow always on TV whenever a disaster happens.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:35.220
    | text      = Yeah, he's the Forrest Gump of oh shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:37.140
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:38.500
    | text      = So, uh, Harrison is being alerted that there's video.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:42.500

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = far away and isn't all that graphic.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:47.539
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:48.660
    | text      = Oh my God.

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = And the video that we were just seeing for our radio listeners was shot from a rooftop

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

    | text      = Can we, can we play it again, guys?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = And twist.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:19.940
    | text      = Oh my God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:20.660
    | text      = I hope he's okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:21.299
    | text      = So we don't know if he's alive or dead.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:22.660
    | text      = We don't know how serious the damage is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:26.740
    | text      = This is a really tough situation to be in, obviously.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:29.859
    | text      = And I think that, um, you know, I'm not going to say, uh, tip, tip my hat to Harrison or
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:35.940
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:36.339
    | text      = But like, at least there is a clear, uh, feeling of, of like, well, there's, this is news.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Shit just got actual real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = We're not doing Info Wars bullshit right now, guys.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:00.339
    | text      = And at this point, um, you know, like that video that he is playing is the one that's

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Like, I understand that you probably want to rile people up and, you know, whatever,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:32.739
    | text      = but there's an inherent disrespect that I just feel like should be baseline.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:38.980
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:39.460
    | text      = Oh, well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:40.500
    | text      = I think this is a really great exemplar of the difference between talking and doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:47.940
    | text      = Like, Harrison talks such a big game of being a Nazi piece of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:52.739
    | text      = Alex is a Nazi piece of shit, to his core.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:56.340
    | text      = Emphasis on piece of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:57.780
    | text      = To his fucking core.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:52:59.219
    | text      = Because I think that there's some piece of shit parts of him that are Nazi-ish,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:02.579
    | text      = and there's some parts that are different, that are still piece of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:05.380
    | text      = You know, they're more.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:07.460
    | text      = There's an evolution of piece of shitery.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:10.099
    | text      = He's a dynamic piece of shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:12.019
    | text      = Yeah, but it is like, there are a lot of people in life who just talk shit,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:16.980
    | text      = and they talk a big fucking game, but when it comes down to it, like, that's a human life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:22.980
    | text      = Alex is fucking not that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:24.340
    | text      = He does not care.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:25.059
    | text      = Alex is not that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:26.420
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:26.820
    | text      = Alex does not give a fuck.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:28.420
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:28.980
    | text      = That's really the feeling that I got from this, you know, albeit fairly brief time that they
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:36.579
    | text      = were covering this on the episode, was that Harrison has a slightly human response,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:41.300
    | text      = and Alex does not care at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:43.059
    | text      = Not even a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:43.539
    | text      = He's interested in guns and how he can use this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:46.340
    | text      = And Owen!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:47.699
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:48.900
    | text      = Well, he makes a Freudian slip a little bit later.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:51.539
    | text      = Oh, he does?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:52.260
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:53.079
    | text      = So, they said that we got a guest host coming in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:53:57.719
    | text      = Jesus Christ, of all the fucking people, who do we gotta have?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:01.400
    | text      = We gotta have pirate murder talk over here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:04.199
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:05.719
    | text      = So we just heard that Charlie Kirk was shot in Utah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:09.960
    | text      = Our prayers go out to him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:11.079
    | text      = Hopefully he'll make it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:12.840
    | text      = So big lesson from that is, is that we are already, I'm here to say this,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:17.880
    | text      = but we're already in a civil war, and it's been that way for years against the left.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:21.639
    | text      = Just effing accept reality that they are waging war on this country, on this Constitution,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:26.920
    | text      = and on us, and they don't accept free speech from anybody but themselves.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:31.719
    | text      = That's clear from what happened to Charlie Kirk today.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:34.039
    | text      = They have zero information about who did this shooting or why they did it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:37.480
    | text      = but now we have Stuart Rhodes coming in to whine about how this is part of the left's war
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:41.880
    | text      = on the country, which is already a civil war.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:44.920
    | text      = I often have moments where it feels like Infowars is a full-on parody of itself,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:48.679
    | text      = and this is a great example of that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:50.760
    | text      = Charlie Kirk was just murdered at an event, and less than an hour later,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:54.519
    | text      = the head of a paramilitary group that tried to overthrow the country four years ago is guest
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:54:58.760
    | text      = hosting complaining about the left.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:01.639
    | text      = Even if you just leave out all of the January 6th stuff, leave that to the side.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:05.480
    | text      = True.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:06.039
    | text      = His history with the Oath Keepers is plagued with violence pretending to be politics.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:10.679
    | text      = Stuart being the host on this particular day, it just feels like proof of a simulation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:15.079
    | text      = I mean, it's so surreal.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:16.679
    | text      = I think I just did become a Christian because no amount of faith could ever overcome this,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:21.639
    | text      = ironically making my complete lack of faith the only true faith that there could possibly be,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:26.519
    | text      = proving that once and for all there is a God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:28.760
    | text      = Yeah, and like, it's, you know, obviously Alex didn't plan all of this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:35.079
    | text      = You can't possibly have done that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:36.679
    | text      = But it would explain how this has so much irony to it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:39.639
    | text      = I mean, it's steeped.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:42.039
    | text      = It's steeped.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:43.719
    | text      = So one thing that is true is that Alex did need to go pick up his dad, I think,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:48.280
    | text      = because he does not come back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:51.000
    | text      = Instead, I think he drops his dad back off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:54.199
    | text      = Great.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:54.519
    | text      = We were going to go get some ice cream, but dad, sorry.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:57.320
    | text      = No mas.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:57.960
    | text      = I've got to go film a special report.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:55:59.880
    | text      = Oh, God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:00.679
    | text      = So Alex comes back to the studio and films a report about Charlie Kirk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:04.840
    | text      = Oh my God.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:05.719
    | text      = The Democrats just killed Charlie Kirk today.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:08.760
    | text      = They're desperate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:09.639
    | text      = They're losing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:10.440
    | text      = They want to intimidate you and me and everybody else.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:13.320
    | text      = But we won't let the murder of our hero be used against us.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:17.320
    | text      = We'll use this death as an example to celebrate the life of Charlie Kirk
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:21.639
    | text      = and let the globalists know you did this out of weakness.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:25.000
    | text      = And we're now going to peacefully expose you and speak out publicly more than ever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:29.800
    | text      = And then you criminals will be defeated and we'll be going to prison.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:34.039
    | text      = We're about to break it all down right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:36.679
    | text      = By this point, Alex has zero new information,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:39.400
    | text      = but he's very confidently yelling about how the Democrats killed Charlie Kirk.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:43.639
    | text      = Getting things right doesn't matter to Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:45.639
    | text      = All that matters is feelings.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:47.719
    | text      = It's important to understand that Alex is acting this way because he knows that emotions
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:51.719
    | text      = are super high in this moment and that he needs to strike while the iron's hot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:56.039
    | text      = A leading figure in their media space was just publicly killed,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:56:58.920
    | text      = so people are naturally pissed off and a bit scared.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:02.039
    | text      = If Alex were to get on air and say, hey, let's keep our cool and wait till we have some information
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:06.119
    | text      = before we jump to conclusions, he wouldn't be able to exploit those angry and scared
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:10.760
    | text      = feelings that the listeners have.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:13.000
    | text      = When someone is angry and scared, if you try to calm them down,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:16.199
    | text      = you're looking out for their best interests, but you're going to be less able to manipulate them.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:20.599
    | text      = On the other hand, if you tap into that fear and anger,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:23.239
    | text      = you're going to make the situation they're in worse.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:25.639
    | text      = But the energy that those emotions create can be redirected and pointed where you want to aim it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:31.880
    | text      = This is a major trick that Alex has used throughout his career,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:34.679
    | text      = where he exploits the audience's feelings of fear and anger, often around public tragedies,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:39.480
    | text      = and then redirects their feelings towards things that bring him profit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:43.159
    | text      = When you think about Alex's career, what do you think about?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:46.119
    | text      = Is it making shit up about horrible tragedies,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:48.840
    | text      = or is it actually getting to the bottom of crimes and corruption?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:52.519
    | text      = Without the crutch of taking advantage of public trauma, we wouldn't know Alex's name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:57:57.960
    | text      = Everything that's big in his career, 9-11, Sandy Hook, Waco,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:02.280
    | text      = all of it is exploitation of the pain that tragedy causes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:07.000
    | text      = And that should be his legacy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:09.639
    | text      = His talent is not for anything other than recognizing when speed is the most important
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:15.880
    | text      = thing. Beyond all else, beyond everything else, speed. Get there fast.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:22.280
    | text      = And other people's pain alchemy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:24.920
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:25.159
    | text      = That's his skill.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:27.480
    | text      = He's got that. Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:29.239
    | text      = So this was a shot heard around the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:31.400
    | text      = Mm-hmm.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:32.519
    | text      = September 10th, 2025 is a day where a shot was heard around the world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:58:40.440
    | text      = Charlie Kirk was brutally murdered today in Utah while speaking to thousands at an outdoor event
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
